title: State vs. Process: van festve vs. festődik
grammar: Stative resultative passive (van/volt/lesz + -va/-ve) vs. dynamic mediopassive (-ódik/-ődik)
goal: I can use van/volt/lesz + -va/-ve to describe the visible resulting state of a completed action (meg van világítva, ki van állítva)
I can contrast stative van + -va/-ve with ongoing mediopassive processes in -ódik/-ődik (kirajzolódik, tükröződik)
I can describe architectural restoration, lighting, and exhibition states
